svg.aria-label: Constructed heating signals and an empirical fit include two sloping state baselines. The shifted cooling curve illustrates path dependence. The right panel normalizes between same-temperature baselines; a model fraction of 0.5 defines its midpoint. Interpreting that midpoint as equilibrium stability requires reversible equilibrium behavior.
